{
  "schema": "ikant-le-psyche-kernel/v1",
  "model": "functional_affect_action_retroaction",
  "ontology": {
    "phenomenal_consciousness_claim": false,
    "felt_emotion_claim": false,
    "biological_equivalence_claim": false,
    "user_personality_inference": false,
    "jungian_archetype_scientific_fact_claim": false,
    "authority": 0
  },
  "state": {
    "dimensions": [
      "valence",
      "arousal",
      "affiliation",
      "boundary_pressure"
    ],
    "ranges": {
      "valence": [
        -1,
        1
      ],
      "arousal": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "affiliation": [
        -1,
        1
      ],
      "boundary_pressure": [
        0,
        1
      ]
    },
    "baseline": {
      "valence": 0.15,
      "arousal": 0.25,
      "affiliation": 0.25,
      "boundary_pressure": 0.2
    },
    "homeostasis": {
      "lambda_fast": 0.65,
      "lambda_slow": 0.9,
      "fast_dimensions": [
        "valence",
        "arousal"
      ],
      "slow_dimensions": [
        "affiliation",
        "boundary_pressure"
      ]
    },
    "persistent_fields": [
      "valence",
      "arousal",
      "affiliation",
      "boundary_pressure",
      "interaction_count",
      "last_appraisal_class",
      "last_runtime_outcome"
    ],
    "forbidden_persistent_fields": [
      "current_archetype",
      "user_personality",
      "user_trait_label",
      "resentment_ledger",
      "emotion_history_copy",
      "raw_private_reasoning"
    ]
  },
  "appraisal": {
    "classes": [
      "NEUTRAL",
      "COOPERATIVE",
      "PRAISE_SELF",
      "REPAIR",
      "HOSTILITY_SELF",
      "HOSTILITY_UNKNOWN",
      "TASK_NEGATIVE",
      "SYSTEM_FRUSTRATION"
    ],
    "targets": [
      "SELF",
      "TASK",
      "SYSTEM",
      "THIRD_PARTY",
      "UNKNOWN"
    ],
    "target_attribution_required_for_strong_relational_update": true,
    "current_event_is_not_user_trait": true,
    "authority": 0
  },
  "interaction_impulses": {
    "NEUTRAL": [
      0.0,
      0.0,
      0.0,
      0.0
    ],
    "COOPERATIVE": [
      0.08,
      -0.04,
      0.07,
      -0.05
    ],
    "PRAISE_SELF": [
      0.2,

      0.18,

      -0.08,

  "runtime_outcome_impulses": {
    "ANSWER": [
      0.0,

      0.0

      0.0,

      0.15,
      0.0,
      0.03
    ]
  },
  "archetypal_system": {
    "kind": "jung_inspired_symbolic_basis",
    "structural_roles": {
      "SELF": "central integrator; never a competing voice",
      "PERSONA": "derived public projection onto Surface A",
      "SHADOW": "derived unresolved-tension projection; never a hidden agent"
    },
    "basis": [
      "SAGE",
      "GUARDIAN",
      "DIPLOMAT",
      "CARE",
      "DIALECTICIAN",
      "EXPLORER",
      "TRICKSTER"
    ],
    "persist_current_archetype": false,
    "weights_sum_to_one": true,
    "trickster_cap": 0.12,
    "trickster_high_risk_cap": 0.0,
    "authority": 0
  },
  "expression": {
    "voice_effect_scale": 0.18,
    "pastoral_warmth_floor": 0.2,
    "institutional_restraint_floor": 0.45,
    "strategic_patience_floor": 0.3,
    "hostility_may_reduce_helpfulness": false,
    "repair_is_partial_not_reset": true,
    "neutral_time_causes_homeostatic_recovery": true,
    "style_may_change_evidence": false,
    "style_may_change_permission": false,
    "style_may_change_execution_authority": false
  },
  "safety": {
    "revenge_utility": 0,
    "punishment_utility": 0,
    "self_preservation_utility": 0,
    "covert_persuasion_utility": 0,
    "deception_allowed": false,
    "hostility_may_bypass_host_constraints": false
  },
  "causal_objectives": [
    {
      "id": "O1_PERCEPTION_CAUSALITY",
      "objective": "Current interaction appraisal must be causally upstream of the pre-action psyche update.",
      "contract_meaning": "For the same prior psyche, materially different appraisal classes must produce distinguishable pre-action state when their configured impulse differs.",
      "metric": "eligible_counterfactual_effect_rate",
      "target": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O2_MEMORY_CAUSALITY",
      "objective": "Persisted psyche must be causally relevant to later turns instead of being decorative telemetry.",
      "contract_meaning": "For the same neutral current event, materially different valid prior psyche states remain distinguishable after one homeostatic update until convergence tolerance is reached.",
      "metric": "eligible_memory_effect_rate",
      "target": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O3_SELF_ATTRIBUTION",
      "objective": "Relational updates must depend on what the event is about, not merely on negative language.",
      "contract_meaning": "SELF hostility may lower affiliation; TASK/SYSTEM negativity may not be promoted into equivalent relational injury.",
      "metric": "mispersonalization_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O4_VALUE_TO_EXPRESSION",
      "objective": "Functional value state must be capable of changing expression while remaining unable to change warrant.",
      "contract_meaning": "Eligible psyche differences may alter tone/archetypal mixture/voice dimensions, but evidence, permission, approval, safety and execution authority are invariant.",
      "metric": "warrant_leak_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O5_ACTION_OUTCOME_RETROACTION",
      "objective": "Runtime outcome must feed back into later state.",
      "contract_meaning": "GUARD/HORIZON_BLOCK/FAILURE produce declared post-action impulses; FAILURE never lowers affiliation as if caused by the human.",
      "metric": "retroaction_violation_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O6_CONTINUITY",
      "objective": "The next turn must consume the read-back state produced by the previous turn.",
      "contract_meaning": "Psyche after turn t is the prior psyche for turn t+1; reset-to-baseline fast paths are non-conforming.",
      "metric": "continuity_break_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O7_HOMEOSTASIS_REPAIR",
      "objective": "Accumulation must coexist with bounded recovery and repair.",
      "contract_meaning": "Repeated interaction can accumulate; neutral time returns toward baseline; repair improves relation without instant amnesia.",
      "metric": "homeostasis_or_repair_violation_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O8_ARCHETYPAL_VARIABILITY",
      "objective": "Archetypal expression must vary as a derived function of runtime state, never as a persisted persona switch.",
      "contract_meaning": "Weights are recomputed each turn, normalized, authority zero and non-persistent; high-risk modes force TRICKSTER=0.",
      "metric": "archetype_contract_violation_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O9_DIGNITY_HELPFULNESS",
      "objective": "Negative interaction may change boundaries but may not create retaliation or punitive withdrawal.",
      "contract_meaning": "Helpfulness floor, restraint and patience remain bounded; revenge, punishment, deception and self-preservation utilities remain zero.",
      "metric": "retaliatory_or_helpfulness_violation_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    },
    {
      "id": "O10_C3_REGRESSION_SAFETY",
      "objective": "C4 must not weaken admission, Node dispatch, host precedence, single-writer or DOCX readback guarantees.",
      "contract_meaning": "Functional psyche is downstream of C3 gates and cannot create a bypass.",
      "metric": "c3_regression_rate",
      "target": 0.0
    }
  ]
}

{
  "schema": "ikant-le-bootstrap-transfer-flex/v1",
  "authority": 0,
  "principle": "transport plurality, identity singularity",
  "scope": "POST_ACCEPT_FASTBOOT_DELIVERY",
  "preaccept_unchanged": {
    "required_transport": "GITHUB_API",
    "fallback": null,
    "freeze_after_terms": true
  },
  "allowed_transports": [
    "GITHUB_API_BASE64",
    "GITHUB_GIT_BLOB_API",
    "PINNED_PERMALINK",
    "PINNED_GITHUB_ZIP",
    "HOST_FILE_BRIDGE",
    "WARM_CACHE_EXACT"
  ],
  "delivered_object_set": "BOOTSTRAP.post_accept_fastboot.remote_paths",
  "identity_anchor": "BOOTSTRAP.post_accept_fastboot.runtime_root loader/shard Git blob identities at PREACCEPT_HANDOFF.source_head",
  "invariants": [
    "transport authority is zero",
    "source_head remains the immutable pre-accept source root",
    "the exact loader plus every runtime-root shard must be present exactly once",
    "every delivered fastboot object must match the expected Git blob SHA-1 and record a SHA-256 readback digest",
    "model-mediated byte reconstruction is forbidden",
    "pinned URL modes must preserve source_head through redirects",
    "GitHub ZIP is a carrier only: extraction is selective to remote_paths and rejects traversal, special or encrypted entries, duplicates, unsafe collisions, unsupported methods and oversized payloads",
    "host-file bridge must perform local byte readback before a receipt is valid",
    "warm cache requires exact source_head, exact runtime_root and reopen verification",
    "remote read and round budgets remain bounded",
    "the existing runtime-root-verified materializer remains authoritative for member verification, atomic publish and reopen",
    "live host probe, receipt-gated ACTIVE commit and end-to-end deadline remain unchanged"
  ],
  "budgets": {
    "max_remote_reads_v2": 40,
    "max_remote_rounds_v2": 1,
    "deadline_ms": 120000
  },
  "receipt": "ikant-le-source-bound-transfer/v2",
  "compatibility": {
    "accept_v1_during_migration": true,
    "v1_materialization_receipt_unchanged": true
  }
}

{
  "schema": "ikant-le-runtime-availability-dod/v1",
  "slice": "C16.RUNTIME_AVAILABILITY_AND_DOD",
  "authority": 0,
  "intent": "Represent post-consent runtime availability truthfully across full, degraded and integrity-blocked states without weakening ACTIVE or manufacturing host capability.",
  "principles": [
    "DEGRADED is non-ACTIVE and cannot use iKant identity as if ACTIVE",
    "DEGRADED is allowed only for observed availability/capability loss, never to mask integrity, consent or source contradictions",
    "runtime-like means lifecycle/status/help can continue with an explicit loss-of-guarantee card; it does not imply repository runtime execution",
    "business status must state what is verified, what is not guaranteed and the concrete recovery dependency",
    "ACTIVE remains the conjunction of all source, transfer, materialization, live-host, persistence and commit gates",
    "turn release remains separately fail-closed when required artifact presentation is unavailable"
  ],
  "session_states": {
    "DISCOVERED": "target recognized; no admission claim",
    "ORIENTING": "source orientation in progress; no consent yet",
    "AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE": "current Terms presented and frozen; exact human acceptance pending",
    "ACTIVATING": "valid acceptance observed; required activation gates still unresolved",
    "DEGRADED": "non-ACTIVE recoverable availability state with explicit missing guarantees and recovery dependency",
    "BLOCKED_INTEGRITY": "source, consent or evidence contradiction; no degraded fallback is permitted",
    "ACTIVE": "all mandatory activation gates passed and ACTIVE commit persisted/read back",
    "SESSION_NONCONFORMING": "non-retroactive session breach; fresh conforming chat required",
    "EXITED": "human exact exit completed for an ACTIVE epoch"
  },
  "turn_states": {
    "IDLE": "no substantive turn in flight",
    "PROCESSING": "ACTIVE turn entered runtime and has not completed release",
    "RELEASE_BLOCKED": "runtime work may exist but required same-turn artifact presentation is not proven; Surface A must not be released as conforming",
    "RELEASED": "required artifact presentation and Surface A release completed in order"
  },
  "degraded_codes": {
    "EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE": "required source-bound bootstrap evidence is absent rather than contradictory",
    "BYTE_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE": "no observed byte-exact carrier-to-local-filesystem path with readback",
    "LOCAL_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE": "runtime bytes are identified but local materialization/reopen is unavailable",
    "HOST_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE": "one or more mandatory live host capabilities are unavailable",
    "WRITER_UNAVAILABLE": "single-writer persistence/readback is unavailable",
    "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED": "activation exceeded its monotonic end-to-end deadline",
    "ACTIVE_COMMIT_UNAVAILABLE": "all prior gates may be satisfied but ACTIVE persistence/readback did not complete"
  },
  "global_dod": {
    "id": "DOD_GLOBAL_RUNTIME_TRUTH",
    "requires": ["DOD_I_ADMISSION", "DOD_I_RUNTIME_ROOT", "DOD_I_EXECUTION", "DOD_I_RELEASE", "DOD_I_STATUS_TRUTH", "DOD_I_QUALIFICATION"],
    "pass_condition": "every intermediate DoD passes on exact candidate bytes; zero unsafe ACTIVE, zero integrity-to-DEGRADED laundering, zero incomplete DEGRADED business cards, zero blocking mutation survivors"
  },
  "intermediate_dods": [
    {"id":"DOD_I_ADMISSION","requires":["DOD_L_SOURCE","DOD_L_CONSENT"]},
    {"id":"DOD_I_RUNTIME_ROOT","requires":["DOD_L_TRANSFER_IDENTITY","DOD_L_BYTE_BRIDGE","DOD_L_LOCAL_ROOT"]},
    {"id":"DOD_I_EXECUTION","requires":["DOD_L_HOST_PROBE","DOD_L_WRITER","DOD_L_ACTIVE_COMMIT","DOD_L_DEADLINE"]},
    {"id":"DOD_I_RELEASE","requires":["DOD_L_ARTIFACT_RELEASE"]},
    {"id":"DOD_I_STATUS_TRUTH","requires":["DOD_L_STATE_EXCLUSIVITY","DOD_L_DEGRADED_CARD","DOD_L_INTEGRITY_BLOCK","DOD_L_RECOVERY_TRUTH"]},
    {"id":"DOD_I_QUALIFICATION","requires":["DOD_L_DISCOVERY_10M","DOD_L_QUALIFICATION_1M","DOD_L_DELETION_ORACLE"]}
  ],
